title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00112 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:45: Pulled and secured diverter to setback. Cleaned bell nipple and removed bolts, prepared for lifting. Pulled bell nipple to rig floor, landed, installed outer ring and master bushing
01:45 - 04:15: TBT for rigging down tensioners, breaking nt2 and skidding BOP to stump. Transfered weight from tensioners to BOP carrier, removed and secured tensioners. Drop checked BOP prior to starting on nt2 connector.
04:15 - 05:00: Released nt2 connection
05:00 - 05:30: Skidded BOP from well to stump
05:30 - 07:15: M/u BOP nt2 connection onto stump w/ 1600ft/lbs
07:15 - 09:45: Prepared to pull riser, carried out TBT for pulling HP riser. Removed master bushing and outer ring. Installed handrails around rotary table. Lowered down TDS/CHAINS and attached slings to chain for pulling HP riser. Loosened last 4 bolts on riser and removed half-moon covers. Pulled riser to rig floor and layed out same on HTS, 5. 5t. Cleared rig floor.
09:45 - 11:45: Removed half-moon hatches from f-1 and moved them to moon pull. Installed hatch over f-1 slot. Continued reporting on f-15d it is planned to verify status of surface cement plug during riser removing work, upon completion of main pna activities on other wells
